svg.title: Riju and Cecil sort five kinds of unresolved civic record.
svg.desc: Five distinct source conflicts surround the red-marked anomaly file: landmark addresses, seasonal movement, name variants, biometric failures, and ownership disputes. Riju calls them unanswered questions; Cecil classifies them as unknown.
svg.text: Page 23, panel 1 · Overhead wide shot of the terminal, anomaly file, and five source piles

text.tspan: Riju and Cecil isolate the remaining cases and
confirm that none can honestly be resolved before
